mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DAILY_BATCH_EXECUTION (job_name, business_date, status, owner_id, lease_token, lease_until, started_at) VALUES (#{execution.jobName}, #{execution.businessDate}, #{execution.status}, #{execution.ownerId}, #{execution.leaseToken}, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseDurationSeconds} SECOND), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE DAILY_BATCH_EXECUTION SET status = #{execution.status}, owner_id = #{execution.ownerId}, lease_token = #{execution.leaseToken}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{leaseDurationSeconds} SECOND), started_at = NOW(), completed_at = NULL, error_summary = NULL WHERE job_name = #{execution.jobName} AND business_date = #{execution.businessDate} AND (status != 'RUNNING' OR lease_until < NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT daily_batch_execution_id AS id, job_name AS jobName, business_date AS businessDate, status, owner_id AS ownerId, lease_token AS leaseToken, lease_until AS leaseUntil, started_at AS startedAt, completed_at AS completedAt, error_summary AS errorSummary, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM DAILY_BATCH_EXECUTION WHERE job_name = #{jobName} AND business_date = #{businessDate}
